hold_reason: review: Alibaba: Incorrect definition. A Swiss Challenge is a procurement method where the lowest bidder is invited to match a pre-determined price, not a process of re-bidding on a better offer.
objections: Alibaba: Incorrect definition. A Swiss Challenge is a procurement method where the lowest bidder is invited to match a pre-determined price, not a process of re-bidding on a better offer.
NVIDIA: Term not recognized under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code; Swiss challenge is a procurement/bidding method, not an IBC term.
